theorems.name: Submission.rsod_exists_least_integer_density_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ V.mult x = k) → ∀ ξ ∈ V.support, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ (N : ℕ) (x₀ : Amb n ℓ), 1 ≤ N ∧ x₀ ∈ ball ξ r ∧ V.HasDensity x₀ N ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ ball ξ r → (N : ℝ) ≤ V.mult x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
